title: Which of five excise duties gets the States of Eskerholm's GBP 1.5 million 2027 Budget envelope, and how much excess burden the cut removes in 2027, with Customs' excise on releases from bonded warehouses by duty and quarter, October 2025 to September 2026
subdomain: elasticity-welfare-policy-impact-estimation (the excess burden a duty cut removes in the Budget year, on the whole existing wedge and the response made within the year)
prompt_shape: 07: one of five duties with its sized excess burden removed, the runner-up and its figure, and a grid of five duties by four quarters of excise on releases (20 figures)
stated_inputs: the appraisal manual's Budget year, starting point, revenue cost, pass-through and what counts towards excess burden (treasury_budget_appraisal_manual_2026.pdf)
CE14's accounting period, amendment, repayment and removal rules (customs_excise_accounting_note_ce14.pdf)

sources.origin: generated by task118/generator/make.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional island government with five excise duties: the statistics office's quarterly clearances and shelf prices from 2008 drawn from a partial-adjustment demand at constant prices, the duty and GST rates, the treasury's appraisal manual, customs' line-level declarations for July 2025 to September 2026 with its procedure codes, accounting note and warehouse register; layouts follow the public files named, every organisation, place and person is invented, and no real dataset is reproduced.
